omissions.source: To ensure high-quality generations, we train all the diffusion models for a minimum of 1M steps. To quantify the attribute distribution, we then generate the same number of samples as the number of samples used to train the model.
All models are trained on a single NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU using images of size 256 × 256.

for GAN-based models trained on FFHQ subsets, the perceptual quality of male images is either higher or comparable to that of female images. On the other hand, for GAN models trained on FairFace-BW data subsets, the female perceptual quality is higher or comparable
One possible explanation for this phenomenon is that the model complexity exceeds the complexity of the training data, resulting in overfitting to the training data.
